title: [Chapitre] VIII. Analysis situs (quatrième mouture) : notes manuscrites (26/06-04/07/1986).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting: Grothendieck is axiomatising a combinatorial 'analysis situs'. There is a set M of 'figures' with three relations. X ≪ Y is a strong inclusion. X ≤ Y is 'X is a face/subfigure of Y'. X |∘| Y is non-overlap. Each figure X has a boundary ∂X and a set X̃ of elementary constituents (cells) Y ≤ X. On the previous page he checked that the map X ↦ molécules(X) (into elementary figures on a lattice L) respects these relations. That was evidence that his notion of a 'combinatoire' from p. 27 is sensible.

On this page he asks for a point-set 'support' functor: a map X ↦ |X| from M to P(P), the power set of a set P of 'points'. The minimal axioms are:
(i) X ≪ Y ⇒ |X| ⊂ |Y|, so the support is monotone for ≪, hence also for its variants and for ≤.
(ii) The interior |X|° := |X| \ |∂X| is non-empty.
(iii) X |∘| Y ⇔ |X|° ∩ |Y|° = ∅: non-overlap means the interiors are disjoint.
(iv) Normalisation: |M| = P, and the interiors |X|° separate points.

Margin notes:
- He wants to extend the support to subsets by |A| = ∪_{X∈A} |X|.
- He labels which relation each axiom controls.
- He observes that (ii) follows from (iii). Since no figure is non-overlapping with itself, |X|° ∩ |X|° ≠ ∅.

NB, separation of points: take x ∈ |X| and y ∉ |X|. One wants a subfigure Y ≤ X with x ∈ |Y|°. Then y ∉ |Y|° holds automatically, because |Y|° ⊂ |Y| ⊂ |X|. So the question is whether the interiors of the cells Y ∈ X̃ cover |X|.

This leads to a strengthened axiom (ii bis): for each X, the family (|Y|)_{Y∈X̃} is the decomposition (into elementary cells) of the support |X| induced by X. In modern terms, |X| is a regular cell complex, or stratified set, whose strata are the |Y|°.

Consequence: Y ↦ |Y| is injective on X̃. If Y ≠ Y' in X̃, then Y |∘| Y', so |Y|° ∩ |Y'|° = ∅ by (iii). Both interiors are non-empty by (ii), hence |Y| ≠ |Y'|.

The next page continues the programme:
- It proves |X| = ⊔_{Y∈X̃} |Y|°.
- It asks whether |Y| ⊂ |Z| ⇒ Y ≤ Z, i.e. whether the face order is recovered from inclusion of closed supports.

Purpose: to connect the purely combinatorial theory of figures to a 'geometric realisation' in a point set. This is analogous to realising an abstract cell complex or face poset by closed cells whose open interiors partition the space.
errors: The final step of the injectivity argument should conclude |Y| ≠ |Y'|, not 'Y ≠ Y''; the latter is the hypothesis. This is likely a slip in the transcription or in the note.

As stated, (iii) only gives pairwise disjointness of interiors, not that they cover |X|. Hence the need for (ii bis), which Grothendieck himself recognises. The formulation of (ii bis) is still vague (what 'partition into elementary pieces' means precisely).
In (iv), 'separate the points of X₀' is unclear; it probably refers to separating the points of P or of the support.

ideas.what: Axiomatic support map from an abstract poset of combinatorial figures to subsets of a point set, compatible with inclusion, boundary/interior and non-overlap
ideas.modern_name: geometric realisation of a regular cell complex / face poset; stratified support
ideas.usually_credited_to: regular CW complexes and face posets: Björner (1984), with older work on cell complexes; Grothendieck's tame-topology ideas in Esquisse (1984)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses tame topology only in general terms

ideas.what: Interior defined as support minus support of the boundary; non-overlap ⇔ disjoint interiors; (ii) deduced from (iii)
ideas.modern_name: open cells / strata of a cell decomposition

ideas.what: Axiom (ii bis): the open interiors of the elementary cells of X partition |X|, so cells inject into subsets; question whether the face order is recovered from inclusion of closed cells
ideas.modern_name: CW/regular cell complex: the face poset is determined by closure inclusion

deep.surprise_reason: This is a routine axiomatisation step: support maps, interiors, and the partition of a support into open cells. It parallels standard regular-cell-complex theory and is exploratory, with no novel result.
transcription_corrections: Margin note reads approximately 'On veut déf. aussi, pour A ⊂ M, |A| = ∪_{X∈A} |X|'.
The reference reads 'Compare Cf VII, p. 73' (chapter VII), not 'CT VII'.
The final line of the injectivity argument should read 'donc par (ii) |Y| ≠ |Y'|'. The struck text after it is a crossed-out 'Comme on sait je dis que'.
Margin by (ii): 'concerne ≤ (est impliqué par (iii))', referring to the redundancy of (ii).
